scope: isolated session only; no deployment or production changes

secret.name: SEO_OPENAI_API_KEY
secret.source: Provision directly into the authorized isolated runtime secret store; never export from another project

requiredNonSecretConfiguration.SEO_CONTENT_INFERENCE_AUTHORIZED: true only after explicit spending authorization
requiredNonSecretConfiguration.SEO_CONTENT_APPROVED_BUDGET_MICROS: explicit approved integer, 1 to 2000000; no spending default
requiredNonSecretConfiguration.SEO_CONTENT_AUDIT_MODEL: authorized model ID different from writer

contract.localMode: Generated in memory as http://127.0.0.1:<ephemeral>/editorial with a random bearer token; never externally bound
contract.externalMode: Existing authorized HTTPS endpoint plus SEO_CONTENT_EDITORIAL_TOKEN (at least 32 characters); API key stays at endpoint owner
